caption:
Your customer list is not one audience. It's at least three.

Most owners send the same win-back text to every past customer. The RFM framework fixes that: sort by Recency (last job), Frequency (how often they book), and Monetary (what they spend).

Three filters change who gets a personal call and who gets a generic text.

Stack all three and your best customers rise to the top. The ones not worth chasing anymore drop off the list too.

rationale: Carousels perform well for saves and engagement on educational B2B content, and this ships a genuinely useful segmentation framework (RFM) for database reactivation distinct from every prior stage, ladder, ownership, aging-bucket, and matrix model already covered.
